title: Personal views, first version: a reader saves a list as 「我的视图」, a user-owned row only they see, then renames, deletes or sets it as their default (#28971 ruling C)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY

立卡门类别: ③ 维护者直派 — the first-version execution card the #28971 ruling orders. Maintainer, on option C 「做个人视图，第一版排在四张卫生卡之后，范围按卡上写的」: 「同意」 (ruling 6570568131, 2026-11-02T06:21Z). Relative dates sub-ruling: 「三点都按 A：相对日期立独立卡，在 #28971 第一版立卡前合入…」 (6572083158).

| ADR-0131 D13 "user-owned D3 object" | holds (L910) |

#29037 (retire the inert `personal` declarations) and #29038 (ADR note) are still open. The ruling does not order them before this card, and this card touches neither file.

## What the first version is

A **named personal view** is a row of user data. It is not view metadata.
- It is a user-owned platform object, modelled on `sys_user_preference` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-preference.object.ts`). Row scope is the owner only. It is never exported with a package and never written through `/meta`.
- Its configuration is spec's `ListView` shape and is validated against it on save, so a bad value is refused loudly. A filter on a field the reader cannot read is already refused by the server.
- Its id does not use the `object.key` view syntax, so it cannot collide with a package view name. No unnamed preference layer sits on top of a personal view.

**In:** save the current list as my view; a 「我的视图」 group in the view switcher; rename; delete; set as my default (reuse the existing pin).
**Not in (不包含):** sharing and team views; admin management and transfer on leaving; a field picker; packaging, import and export. Sharing waits until this version has landed and usage is measured, and it then needs a ruling on whether non-admins may produce environment metadata.

## Steps (two lanes, two PRs, in this order)

1. **`domain:server`**: the platform object, its row scope (owner only, organization-scoped per ADR-0131), and the save-time `ListView` validation, plus tests that pin each of these:
   - another member cannot read, list, update or delete the row;
   - an admin is not given a back door, because the first version has no admin management;
   - an invalid `ListView` body is refused;
   - an unreadable field in the filter is refused at query time.
   No new author-writable protocol key and no `packages/spec/**` schema key. If a spec key turns out to be needed, stop with needs_decision. The object's name is chosen in the PR and stated in its body.
2. **ui lane** (Blocked-by step 1's PR): the switcher's 「我的视图」 group, save-as-my-view available to any reader, rename, delete, and set as my default. It reads the merged set (package views, environment views, my views). Precedents: #27943 for the switcher, objectui#12471 for user-owned list state.

## 业务理由

A salesperson keeps two to four working sets on one list, such as 「我的本周跟进」. Today a reader has one unnamed setting per view, so a new filter overwrites the last one, and a second set lives only in a browser bookmark. Creating a view is admin-only and visible to everyone. Without this card the end state that ADR-0017, #7611 and ADR-0131 D13 all name stays empty, and an author or the assistant keeps writing `scope: 'personal'`, which saves but is visible to everyone.

## 动手的读者

Step 1: `domain:server` seat 1, which claims it on this card next. Step 2: a ui-lane seat once step 1's PR lands. While ui seats are vacant, the coordinator routes it.
